review: Fresh replay reproduces the clock primitive draft ledger: eight contiguous function records covering 264 code bytes, six four-byte literal records (24 bytes), and five candidate review references. Each code record binds a selected source map’s instruction and pseudocode hashes to its byte span; the six data records are taken from pinned PC-relative literals in map references and carry their raw values. The output remains accepted:false/draft_partial.
limitations: Review references are discovered by a text scan and remain leads, not exact revision-bound verdicts; a later binding pass is separate.
Literal uses are candidate consumer references, not reachability or global code/data ownership proof.
The ledger is local and does not establish completeness, semantic admission, implementation readiness, or gates.
